title: On-call handoff - Noah Thompson
content:
Shift: 2026-03-02 19:00 → 2026-03-03 07:00
Owner: Noah Thompson (handing to Lexi Martin at 07:00)
Summary/State of systems:
- All main serving clusters (us-west-1, eu-west-1) green in Redwood Console as of 06:40; small spike in token latency on us-west-1 around 03:10 (p95 420ms → 720ms) but resolved after rolling restart of pool-a-3.
- Redis prefix cache miss rate steady ~4.5% (expected baseline 4–6%)
- One ongoing customer-facing error: INC-4872 (model load failures for customer: acme-corp) — intermittent, root cause suspected: corrupted checkpoint on dedicated node group (dedicated-5).
Incidents and actions taken:
- INC-4872 (priority P1 → P2): first alerted 2026-03-03 01:12. Symptoms: model fails to load with "checkpoint checksum mismatch" on dedicated-5.
  - Actions so far: collected model server logs (/var/log/modelserver/modelserver-2026-03-03.log), rotated out dedicated-5 from LB, triggered redeploy of model bundle from s3://redwood-models/acme/2026-02-18.
  - Current state: redeploy in progress; no confirmed successful reload yet. Customer notified via CS (ticket JIRA-INC-4872).
  - Next steps: if reload fails by 08:00 UTC escalate to infra lead (Samir Ali) and request VM reprovision (follow private-deployments reprovision checklist).
Temporary runbook (quick steps) for model load failures (draft):
1) Check Console > Dedicated > Pools > dedicated-5 > health and logs.
2) SSH to node (ssh svc@dedicated-5.internal) and tail /var/log/modelserver/* for checksum/migration errors.
3) Validate S3 bundle integrity: aws s3 cp s3://redwood-models/acme/2026-02-18/manifest.json - | jq .checksum (compare with local).
4) If manifest mismatch, re-sync from model-store-replica: rsync model-store:/replica/acme/2026-02-18 /tmp/acme-2026-02-18 && verify checksums.
5) If node repeatedly fails: remove from LB, trigger redeploy via infra-deploy job (CI job: infra/deploy-model-bundle, param bundle=acme/2026-02-18).
6) Notify CS and set incident status to "under investigation".
Notes/to-dos (open):
- Follow up with model-onboarding team to get canonical copy of acme-corp bundle (assigned to Maya).
- Add a healthcheck for model checksum mismatches to the model-agent (ticket: TODO-113).
- Draft a permanent runbook entry in Confluence; current draft link in linked_artifacts.
- Check whether the redeploy job used quantized artifact (q4f16) or full fp16 — sometimes wrong artifact path created by pipeline.
Temporary procedure for KV-cache overflow alerts: (observed 2026-02-28, not happening this shift but leaving steps)
- Symptom: model server OOMs when KV cache grows aggressively for long-sequence workloads.
- Quick mitigation: reduce per-request max_tokens to 1024 at the router layer (route policy: long-seq->throttled) and enable immediate prefix-cache eviction for sessions older than 1h.
- Permanent: set automated eviction rules in router config (ticket: OPTIMIZE-77).
Quick commands cheat-sheet (use with caution):
- Check modelserver logs: sudo journalctl -u modelserver -f --since "1 hour ago"
- Redeploy model bundle (CI): curl -X POST https://ci.redwood.internal/job/infra/deploy-model-bundle -d '{"bundle":"acme/2026-02-18","pool":"dedicated-5"}' (note: need CI token)
- Rotate node from LB: infractl pool rotate-node --pool dedicated-5 --node dedicated-5-3
- Check console health via API: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.internal/api/v1/pools/dedicated-5/health
Communication log (what I told customer/CS):
- 2026-03-03 01:45: CS notified (ticket JIRA-INC-4872 created), explained we're redeploying bundle and will update in 2 hours.
- 2026-03-03 02:20: Updated CS: still in progress, no successful reload; logs show checksum mismatch.
Known issues / context (notes to self and next oncall):
- We're still seeing intermittent artifacts from last model-push pipeline (2026-02-18). Prior incident on 2026-02-20 had similar checksum issues — root cause traced to intermittent ECC errors on s3-replica host; HW team replaced disk then. Need to confirm replica health.
- There is a weak circuit breaker currently: when bundle reload fails 3x, pool-level fallback should trigger to model-variant v2-lite, but the fallback didn't trigger for acme-corp due to missing variant mapping. TODO to add mapping.
Unresolved questions:
- Did the model-onboarding pipeline produce two manifest formats last month? (Maya to confirm)
- Is there current drift between model-store primary and replica? (Samir to run full sync check)
- Who owns the infra/deploy-model-bundle CI token rotation? (Ops-secrets team?)
End-of-shift checklist for the receiving oncall (Lexi):
- Confirm INC-4872 status and post update to slack #sre-oncall.
- If redeploy fails by 08:00 UTC, escalate to Samir + infra triage channel and request reprovision of dedicated-5.
- Run quick replica health check: ssh model-store-replica 'du -sh /replica/acme/2026-02-18 && md5sum /replica/acme/2026-02-18/*' (careful with load).
- Review router policy for long-seq clients and ensure throttling rules still in place.
- Add the runbook items above to Confluence (link in header).
Notes to self: keep commands in quick-access snippet in  ~/.oncall/snippets for fast copy-paste.
